diffusion_bf16.precision_exception: Separate explicitly approximate arithmetic experiment: BF16 autocast only in diffusion score network. All weights stored FP32; outer diffusion state, guidance, alignment, confidence and trunk retain existing FP32 path. Record effective linear/output dtypes.
